author: Idgafwhatthenameis
title: Did not receive an in game item paid for with cash
content: I have played and lived this game for years with zero issues. Until this past week when I bought something called an “episode pass”. I bought this on their website which you can access for extra rewards and purchases separate from the AppStore. I’ve made purchases like this before, however this one I was never awarded the product in which I bought. So like anyone probably would, I contacted their support team. Which they then asked for a screenshot of proof that I thought this item. So I gave them exactly that. They then never replied again to me. I sent probably about 20 messages before I finally got a reply a day later from a different member of the support team. And what did they ask me for? Another screenshot. Sure I was happy to oblige. Then they did not respond and I again sent a bunch of messages hoping to get their help. Two days later, I get a reply from yet another person from the support team, this is now three different people mind you. And what did they ask for? Another screenshot. I gave it. And what am I doing now? Waiting so far two days for their reply. And do you think they will get back to me? I don’t think so. I believe another person from support will yet again ask for a screenshot today or tomorrow. And this will never be resolved for me, so I’m out $20. So DONT MAKE IN GAME PURCHASES!!! Save yourself the time and money they will drain out of you. I sadly will have to go through my bank to get a refund as they aren’t even letting me open up another support request. I’m stuck on this same request every time I open the help tab. With different team members in and out. THANKS CG!

author: Spicyzit
title: Great game
content: This is honestly such a great game. It’s fun to build a collection of different characters and compete in PvP action. It has a dynamic unlike most other games, and is genuinely very fun. However, the game is increasingly getting pay to win. It’s almost impossible to complete any galactic legends journey guides. Many of them require countless months of simulating and grinding to even get close, as there are no shipment or purchase options. I recently bought a light speed bundle that would help me ‘chase Supreme Leader Kyle Ren!’ It was lacking in the Finalizer capital ship but to acquire that you either have to grind for months and years, or pay an absurd additional $20. It wouldn’t be so bad to pay for these things if they didn’t cost so much. Journey Guides, Era Units, and genuinely most things in the game are asking you to pay a very high price for what you are getting. It’s honestly frustrating and I encourage the developers to do something about this. Like I said, great game, but takes a lot of time and costs too much if you want to progress faster. Thank you.

author: Welcome4awhile
title: MK 7 Kryotech Shock Prod
content:
The new updates and compensation models are excellent with exception to: 
1 MK 7 Kryotech Shock Prods are not readily accessible through means other than Crydtals, Legend Tokens. All characters need this resource to advance past gear level 8-13 but it one of the hardest to acquire. 
2 Characters requiring MK 3 Guile Event Tokens EXCLUSIVELY to advance past 4star are next to impossible to grade. 
3. When a User risks 5 Sim Cards for 5 HARD Battles, that User should come away with at least 1 shard of the Primary Character listed as one of the reward possibilities.

- 2stars automatically for the Coliseum Battles allowing for a continuous loop which wastes your time. Getting a boss to 90% damage in 3-4 minutes then the boss or bosses seemingly take triple the amount of damage already dealt but never losing additional hit points. ( with healing abilities this causes for a loop of wasted time.) and frustration.

author: TresDubz
title: Amazing game, truly.
content:
This game is AMAZING! The turn-based strategy battles and unlockable characters are great, guild events and guilds in general are fun, and the art style and modeling is smooth and doesn’t lag behind in performance. All in all, it’s a really fun game.

One suggestion I have is to add a “multi-open” button for Bronzium Data Cards, as it can take a very long time to open them all if you wait and let them build up.

One more suggestion (sorry I’m boring you probably lol) is to add way more stormtrooper variants. There are so many other variants shown in the movies, shows, and other content that are very interesting and could have a lot of potential in the gameplay!

Hope this review was helpful, bye!!!

My favorite thing is as you level up you can do different kinds of battles. Like there is guild raids, colosseum, cantina battles, and even battles in space! author: ACToby
title: Lost My Account
content: I lost my account last year around this time because the Support guy told me to unbind my account and delete my app. I asked if it would delete my account and he had assured me that it would not since I still had it saved on my phone. I asked a bunch of other questions but he kept saying he could recover it if anything on his end. I did it and all of a sudden he couldn’t do anything and just sent me the link to the FAQs. Then closed the ticket. Ever since then I have tried to play this game but it’s not the same. I wish that I could recover my old account. But I kept opening tickets and they all said it’s gone forever. Except it was still in the game because my friend had me in the guild. It’s lame. So learn from me. Never unbind your account.
